title: Chala Bimaar Chala Bimaar
body:
Chala bimaar chala bimaar
Islam bacchane ko islam bacchane ko
1. Fateh alam ke liye deen ke parcham ke liye
Sha e ke matam ke liye zinda is gham ke liye
Kofa o Shaam ki purqaar har ek manzil par
Touq o zanjeer sambhale hove in rahoon par ek bimaar chala ek bimaar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zulm karta hai jahan ashk hai gham se rawan
Ya Ali aao yahan nahi milti hai amaa
Betiyaan Fatima zehra ki rasan basta hai
Beridah Shaam se tatheer ke waris lekar deen ka salaar chala deen ka salaar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haye aye zainul ibaa tera matam hai bapa
Tujh sa hai aye sha e huda hum kaha rooye bhala
Ashk akhoun se nahi khoon baha karta tha
Gham mein shabbir ke chalees baras ro ro kar aaj gham qar chala sha e ka gham qar
Azz mir dawar Ali dawar
